changelog: Maintainer-reviewed Cloudflare Web Analytics identity from official documentation; context-dependent consent, with policy disclosure checked independently. No new executable probe.

sources.quote: Hotjar is a heatmap, session recording and survey tool for websites, owned by Contentsquare since 2021.
In order to process data about your visit to a website, Hotjar stores first-party cookies on your browser.
Hotjar is used to see how visitors behave on a website, through heatmaps, session recordings and on-site surveys
Hotjar stores first-party cookies on your browser.

vendors.name: Cloudflare Web Analytics
vendors.category: cookieless website analytics and performance monitoring
collects: page-load timing and Core Web Vitals
vendors.consentRationale: Cloudflare documents this beacon as cookieless performance analytics without cross-site visitor tracking. Loading it before interaction alone does not establish a consent violation; requirements depend on the deployment and applicable rules.

sources.quote: The Web Analytics performance beacon loads from https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js.
Cloudflare Web Analytics does not use any client-side state, such as cookies or localStorage, to collect usage metrics.

vendors.addedBy: maintainer review of observed beacon and official Cloudflare documentation
